Alaqan authorities have posted on social media and made statements in the midst of the government shutdown: Bayarma the Second, the Khagan of Alaqar, has unfortunately passed away at the age of 63 years old. She was taken to the East Shiganuur Hospital, where she received treatment from numerous medical staff in an effort to save her. However, it was not to be, as Bayarma was never able to recover and was pronounced dead twenty minutes after arriving.

Now, representatives from the Faxriysud, Buyuksud and Bayarmas former advisors are posted within the House of White Flowers, the late Khagans home, and are discussing the future of the state. Discussions over how Sadryne should take power, how Bayarmas funeral arrangements will proceed and how Alaqar as a whole will move forward. All the while, millions across the country mourn her death and pray that Alaqar can move forward peacefully without her.

[i]By unanimous vote, the Republic of [nation]Bascover[/nation] has been invited to the Four Eyes Agreement (now the Five Eyes) as a full member of the treaty. Pending the signing of the treaty, Bascover will be obliged to act in the interests of the four main pillars of the treaty, which are as follows:

[list=1][*]Intelligence: partnership nations will agree to work together in coordinating counterintelligence efforts against hostile forces, while sharing any information they may have that is imperative to ensuring the security of the Argos region is maintained

[*]Standardisation: Partnership nations will agree to use the same ammunition types for ease of trading technology

[*]Advanced capability: partnership nations will agree to share military technology with one another that promotes the advancement of the following fields:
[list=a][*]Submarine warfare
[*]Quantum technology
[*]Cyber warfare/Cybersecurity
[*]Hypersonic capability
[*]Long-distance strike capability[/list]

[*]Non-Aggression: Partnership nations agree to not engage in any form of aggression against one another.[/list]

We await the reply from the delegation of Bascover, and sincerely hope they choose to join the treaty. A cooperative Argos is a safe and strong Argos.[/i]

[spoiler=What the Kuhaw-Astan had been doing in 2027]
[b][u]Kuhaw-Astan post civil war rebuilding[/u][/b]

With about one year having passed after the end of the Astanir civil war, and the Kuhaw having gained independence from the rest of Astanir, the government of Kuhaw-Astan can consider the first phase of the  rebuilding and future investment plan of their land to be more or less complete with some areas only a few months behind schedule.

Many parts of the nation's basic infrastructure like roads, electric, water and government services having been restored to a level similar or better than before the civil war, though for some areas this was not exactly supricing as it was not great to begin with, the one thing in particular that was slightly behind is the railway infrastructure as it had not only been heavily damaged in some areas but also had been mined by some of the few leftover pockets of the junta as a sort of petty revenge.

The removal of mines was one area of the first phase that would continue entirely into the next phases of the nation's plan for the future as it is a slow work that cant really be rushed.

[u]Secound phase[/u]
With the year of 2028 having started the second phase of the plan could take its first steps with the rebuilding and upgrading of the nation's industries and education institutions to ensure that the nation would not only survive but hopefully prosper.
Though effort had been put into the restoration of minor industries and mining sectors in the first phase it would not get far more heavy effort and investment put into it as more and more of the military personnel was released into civilian life once more and as such jobs would be in high demand.

While before the civil war the land that is now Kuhaw-Astan had been heavily dependant on resource extraction, especially copper and other metals and minerals that could be found alongside it, for the industry that had been on the southern part of the island that was not something that would be reliable anymore as that part of the island were not part of the same nation anymore, instead Kuhaw-Astan would create its own industry to transform the nation's raw materials into processed goods to bring greater value to the nation with large investment into electronics and semiconductors to take advantage of the lands natural deposits of copper, silicon and other raw materials that is needed in their production.

Three cities have been chosen to be the main centers of this industrial investment; the large port city of Whyalla on the north coast, the port city of Burramatta on the west coast  and the capital city of Muhakay inland near some of the most important mines.

But it was not only the industry that would be focused on in the second phase, the basic government services such as police, fire department and health services will also be improved and modernized, something that was very overdue even a decade ago, together with the nation's power generation to meet the demands of the future that would absolutely arise in the not to distant future as it moved to become a modern nation of the 21st century.

[u]The need for diplomacy.[/u]
To potentially help with this and bring in investment to achieve the full rebuilding and future investment plan that Kuhaw-Astan was going for the leader of the nation, President Pemuluwuy Nuru-Lukywa, would reach out to the large and powerful nation of Vespurias with a diplomatic mission to establish the first diplomatic relation with an outside nation since the end of the civil war to hopefully start trade with the large nation and potentially find investors that would find it interesting to invest in his nations future industry without sacrificing too much ownership in said industries.

While some more nationalistic and isolationist groups have voiced different levels of concern in letting outsiders be allowed to [i]put their fingers into the future of Kuhaw[/i] they have so far been in the minority as most groups and parties seem to understand the necessity of the move if Kuhaw-Astan is to truly achieve its goals for the future, just as they were not blind to the fact that they had needed the aid and cooperation of outsiders in the civil war to attain the level of success that they ended up having.
[/spoiler]

[b]January 16, 2028: A Memo from Polenne Strømm to the state of New Westmore on relations[/b]

To the state of New Westmore,

Greetings from the glorious nation across the sea, whose shine spreads every day across the globe, radiant and strong.

It has come to my attention that you have sought to create relations with our nation, and for that we are grateful.

Indeed, when one ponders the history of New Westmore, and when one traces the lineages of our two nations, you will find there is a connecting and eternal linkage between our two destinies. In the era of the ancients, several thousand years ago it was known that some of the natives who dwell in the state of New Westmore were guided by God to the land that is now Rosenmarkke, settling and establishing a nation across the sea.

It was in this day, upon the foundation of this ancient kingdom, whose name has been lost to the annals of time, that God (who at this time was not known as such, but as merely the spirit) made covenant with our ancestors, the special ancestors chosen of the Thrømm that a great nation would form upon the lands that now Rosenmarkke holds.

It is in this consideration, upon this ancient covenant, that Rosenmarkke accepts any diplomatic discourse between our two nations, may your nation be radiant and glorious as the sun.

Sincerely,
Polenne Strømm
--------_
